description: Content-aware domain blueprints available to TemplateAgent.

templates.name: Document Analysis
templates.description: Format-oriented document analysis retained for explicit requests and compatibility.
templates.selection_hint: Use for PDF, text, Markdown, and document sources that need goal-driven analysis of subjects, claims, evidence, relationships, and limitations.

templates.name: Data Analysis
templates.description: Format-oriented tabular analysis retained for explicit requests and compatibility.
templates.selection_hint: Use for CSV, TSV, Excel, Parquet, and JSON tables that need goal-driven patterns, comparisons, relationships, anomalies, and limitations.

templates.name: Executive Overview
templates.description: Compact decision-facing overview for management audiences.
templates.selection_hint: Use for concise management reports that prioritize KPIs, movement over time, drivers, and actions.

templates.name: Time-series Analysis
templates.description: Evidence-led analysis centered on ordered change and temporal patterns.
templates.selection_hint: Use when the report goal centers on how one or more measures change over an ordered time dimension.

templates.name: Segment Comparison
templates.description: Comparative analysis of categories, cohorts, regions, products, or other segments.
templates.selection_hint: Use when the report compares categories, cohorts, regions, products, or other business segments.

templates.name: Education and Learning
templates.description: Deep analysis of learning material, curricula, pedagogy, outcomes, skills, and educational evidence.
templates.selection_hint: Choose when the content substantially concerns teaching, learning, courses, learners, competencies, assessment, or educational design.

templates.name: Business, Economics and Finance
templates.description: Decision-grade analysis of markets, organizations, strategy, operations, economics, and financial evidence.
templates.selection_hint: Choose when the evidence centers on organizations, markets, money, performance, strategy, operations, or economic behavior.

templates.name: Technology and Engineering
templates.description: Systematic analysis of software, architecture, engineering decisions, technical systems, and innovation.
templates.selection_hint: Choose when the source concerns software, system design, architecture, engineering trade-offs, products, infrastructure, or technical innovation.

templates.name: Health and Wellbeing
templates.description: Careful evidence synthesis for health, wellness, behavior, care delivery, and quality-of-life topics.
templates.selection_hint: Choose when the content materially concerns health outcomes, care, wellbeing, behavior, symptoms, interventions, or quality of life.

templates.name: Society, Culture and Relationships
templates.description: Contextual analysis of communities, identity, relationships, family, marriage, norms, and lived experience.
templates.selection_hint: Choose when the subject concerns social groups, relationships, marriage, family, identity, cultural norms, or lived experience.

templates.name: Media, Arts and Entertainment
templates.description: Interpretive analysis of music, hip-hop, media, narratives, audiences, creative work, and cultural impact.
templates.selection_hint: Choose when the content concerns music or hip-hop, visual or performing arts, media, entertainment, narratives, creators, or audiences.

templates.name: Science, Policy and Environment
templates.description: Evidence-centered analysis of research, public policy, institutions, scientific claims, and environmental systems.
templates.selection_hint: Choose when the source centers on scientific research, public policy, institutions, environment, methods, evidence quality, or societal impact.

templates.name: Adaptive Raw Report
templates.description: Broad, content-neutral blueprint used when no specialized candidate is sufficiently confident.
templates.selection_hint: Use only as the declared low-confidence fallback; adapt sections directly to the available content and plan.
